steps.title: Analyze SpeechRecognizer Lifecycle Requirements
steps.description: Inspect voice assistant speech listening behavior during the 10-minute active session to address beep sounds and restart timing.

steps.title: Optimize SpeechRecognizer Instance Reuse Logic
steps.description: Prevent duplicate SpeechRecognizer initialization by reusing a single shared instance throughout the service lifecycle.

steps.title: Implement Microphone Muted State Handlers
steps.description: Add a dedicated stopSpeechListening method to cancel speech identification safely without calling destroy() unnecessarily.

steps.title: Add Session Expiry Validation Controls
steps.description: Ensure the active 10-minute countdown session expiration properly transitions the engine state back to WAKE_WORD_LISTENING.

steps.title: Introduce Delayed Restart Mechanisms
steps.description: Establish scheduleListening delays to execute restarts sequentially only after the active recognition lifecycle completes.

steps.title: Resolve Repeated System Beep Triggers
steps.description: Utilize debounced retry parameters to prevent rapid mic on/off loops and noisy rapid system beep alerts.

steps.title: Synchronize TTS Speaking callbacks with Mic Active State
steps.description: Configure TextToSpeech callbacks to stop speech listening during utterance playback and resume listening strictly on completion.

steps.title: Preserve Voice Command Features and Settings
steps.description: Ensure all offline utilities like flashlight toggle, battery readout, volume tuning, settings, and alarms remain fully preserved.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Integration Configurations
steps.description: Confirm foreground service permissions and speech intent configuration query selectors comply with target platform settings.

steps.title: Perform Resource Verification against Layout XML
steps.description: Validate localized string configurations and confirm interface elements render diagnostic states accurately.

steps.title: Test Voice Service Event Broadcast Mechanisms
steps.description: Verify broadcast updates dynamically update the MainActivity log monitors and active countdown values.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Verify application stability and finalize resource compilation inside target SDK 34 specifications.
